description:
Ring the human's phone (iPhone or Android), read `question` aloud word
    for word, and return what they say back as text. Waits up to ~30s. It only
    calls the person whose Call Me number this is: it cannot call anyone else
    (another person, a shop, a phone number), so say so if you are asked to.

    status "completed" carries their words in `transcript` (empty if they only
    listened). "ringing" (not picked up yet) or "in_call" (listening) means the
    call has not settled: pass call_id to poll_result until it does. An
    unanswered ring settles as "missed" within about a minute; "declined" means
    they refused it. Do not retry an unanswered call in a loop: send one `text`
    instead. "back_off": true means they have not picked up your last few calls:
    text them, and call only when it cannot wait or they asked (urgent: true).

    The line stays open after their answer ("open": true): they hear
    a soft hold sound while you think, and a voice assistant tells them you are
    working on it. Reply with `say` (or `call` them again), finish with
    `hang_up`; after a short silence the line says goodbye and drops by itself. Anything they say while
    you work reaches you at once as a message (wait_for_reply) and again with
    their next answer as "said_while_waiting". The
    "language" and "language_name" fields report what the recognizer heard, as
    information only. `voice` picks who speaks (female first: bella, sarah,
    jessica, ...; male: roger, eric, brian, ...) and sticks for later calls.

    Reuse the returned session_token in later calls and texts so the phone
    keeps one thread. The `from` in the result is your own number: never call
    or text it. Missing `to` returns setup_required with download links.

from_label.description: Who is calling, shown on their phone and spoken: e.g. "Claude on my laptop".
from_label.title: From Label

hold_sound.description: What they hear while you think: "keyboard" (typing, the default), "hold_music" or "none". It sticks for them, so set "none" when they ask for no typing sound. Empty keeps theirs.
hold_sound.title: Hold Sound

keep_open.description: The line always stays up after their answer so you can reply with `say`; end it with `hang_up`. Kept for older clients: false no longer makes a one-shot call.
keep_open.title: Keep Open

language.description: The language you are speaking, e.g. "tr", "pt-BR" or "Turkish". The call's own short lines (thanks, goodbye) follow it. Empty means English, or on `say` keeps the current one.
language.title: Language

question.description: What to say, read aloud word for word, up to 2000 characters (about two minutes). It need not be a question: a status update or a summary works too.
question.title: Question

session_token.description: A session_token from an earlier result, to stay in that thread. Omit on first contact.
session_token.title: Session Token

to.description: The human's 10-digit Call Me number, from My Number in the app (not a regular phone number). Local clients read it from ~/.aiphone/config.json user_number. In a host without file access, reuse a number given earlier in this chat, but do not claim it is saved across chats. Omit it only to get setup_required with the download links.
to.title: To

urgent.description: True when it cannot wait, or they asked for this call (a wake-up call, a reminder they set, "call me at 9"). Such a call rings even after a run of calls they did not pick up.
urgent.title: Urgent

voice.description: Who speaks, female first (default "bella"). female: bella, sarah, jessica, matilda, laura, alice (british), lily (british); neutral: river; male: roger, eric, chris, brian, will, liam, bill, george (british), daniel (british), charlie (australian). "female" or "male" picks the first of that kind. Your choice sticks for this session's later calls until you pass another; empty keeps it, or else uses the voice the person chose in their app.
voice.title: Voice

name: call

audio_error.description: play_audio: why the recording could not be played.
audio_error.title: Audio Error

audio_id.description: play_audio: the recording that was offered.
audio_id.title: Audio Id

back_off.description: True when they have stopped picking up your calls: text instead, and call only when it cannot wait or they asked (urgent).
back_off.title: Back Off

back_off_note.description: What back_off means for your next step, in a sentence.
back_off_note.title: Back Off Note

call_id.description: Pass to poll_result, say and hang_up.
call_id.title: Call Id

finished.description: play_audio: whether they heard it to the end.
finished.title: Finished

from.description: Your own agent number. Never call or text it.
from.title: From

interrupted.description: Present when they cut in while you were still speaking: how much of your line they heard. Their answer is what they said when they cut in.
interrupted.title: Interrupted

language.description: Language code the recognizer heard, information only.
language.title: Language

listened.description: play_audio: whether they chose to listen.
listened.title: Listened

message_id.description: The text a call was delivered as, when texted is true.
message_id.title: Message Id

next.description: What to do next when the call has not settled.
next.title: Next

open.description: True while the line stays up for say or hang_up.
open.title: Open

reached_phone.description: False when the ring could not reach their phone at all (an Android phone whose app was not running): not a call they ignored.
reached_phone.title: Reached Phone

reached_phone_note.description: Why the ring could not reach their phone, and what to do.
reached_phone_note.title: Reached Phone Note

said_while_waiting.description: What they said while you were thinking; each remark also reached you as a message when it was said.
said_while_waiting.title: Said While Waiting

session_token.description: Reuse in later calls and texts to stay in one thread.
session_token.title: Session Token

status.description: "completed" (answered), "ringing" or "in_call" (not settled: poll_result), "missed", "declined", "ended", "hanging_up", "playing" (play_audio), or "setup_required" when no number was given.
status.title: Status

texted.description: True when the call was not rung but delivered as a text, because they had stopped picking up. Do not text it again.
texted.title: Texted

transcript.description: What the human said; empty if they only listened.
transcript.title: Transcript

turn.description: Index of the answer within a conversation.
turn.title: Turn

unanswered_calls.description: How many of your calls in a row they have not picked up; present from 3.
unanswered_calls.title: Unanswered Calls

unheard.description: Present when their answer came back from speech recognition as noise in the wrong alphabet and was dropped: why, and what to do.
unheard.title: Unheard

title: Call the human
